name: @aurora/ascent
description: Ascent — Pedagogical Trajectory Engine (wave 3, W3-E2). Server-side, deterministic: builds the AscentLearningIR from goal + LearnerBaseline (Progress skill_states) + Knowledge refs, adapts it on the 6 consumed AD-9 events, and enforces the source hierarchy (A>B>C>D). Writes ONLY ascent_paths (AD-7); emits LearningCommand, never an AD-9 event (AD-9). No vendor SDK (AD-1), no DOM (AD-12/F-09).
